title: Project Fundamentals
description: Work plan, deliverables, budget breakdown, and milestone payments — extracted from the Cardano proposal.

fields.activities: Kickoff; decision gate alignment; candidate region list; interview guides; screening criteria; bias control protocols; stakeholder recruitment plan; IRB/ethics confirmation
fields.outputs: Kickoff Report; Research Design Document; Candidate Region List; Approved Interview Guide
fields.narrative: Kickoff, workplan alignment, decision gate review, regional candidate list construction, screening criteria finalisation, ALJ design for primary research phase, stakeholder recruitment plan, interview guide development, bias control protocols.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Regional Screening and Desk Research

fields.activities: RARF application to all candidate clusters; regulatory landscape preliminary scan; use-case viability hypothesis construction; counterparty desk mapping; preliminary infrastructure review
fields.outputs: Preliminary Market Prioritisation Matrix; Screening Review with CPC; Priority Deep-Dive Selection
fields.narrative: Application of the Regional Adoption Readiness Framework to all candidate regional clusters. Initial scores based on publicly available evidence. Production of the preliminary market prioritisation matrix. Identification of priority clusters for deep-dive primary research.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Primary Research and Field Access

fields.activities: Stakeholder interviews across all respondent categories; ALJ facilitation in priority hub locations; expert panels; regulatory expert calls; counterparty mapping refinement; infrastructure assessment
fields.outputs: Stakeholder Access Check (Week 8); Regulatory & Infrastructure Review (Week 10); Interim Findings Review (Week 12)
fields.narrative: Stakeholder interviews, expert calls, ALJ facilitation in selected hub locations, local partner engagement, regulatory mapping, infrastructure assessment, and counterparty mapping. Minimum of 30–45 primary research interactions across respondent types.

fields.activities: RARF score revision with primary evidence; CASS classification of all signals; playbook drafting; regulatory summary writing; counterparty access register compilation; use-case viability assessment completion
fields.outputs: Internal Analysis Memo; Draft Framework Outputs
fields.narrative: Cross-evidence synthesis, RARF score refinement, CASS classification of identified signals, playbook drafting, regulatory summary drafting, counterparty access register compilation.

fields.activities: Full draft of all core deliverables; CPC draft review; validation against decision gates; revision based on review feedback; public summary preparation
fields.outputs: Draft Deliverables Review with CPC (Week 16); Revised Draft
fields.narrative: Full draft of all core deliverables, CPC review, validation against decision gates, revision of findings where access or evidence constraints require recalibration.

fields.activities: Final report; executive decision memo; cross-RFP handoff memo; final presentation to CPC; public summary; evidence register; confidence and limitations register
fields.narrative: Final report, executive decision memo, public summary, cross-RFP handoff memo, presentation to CPC.

payments.title: M1 — Project Inception and Research Design

fields.timing: Kickoff payment (upon contract signature / project start)
fields.trigger: CPC approves Research Design Document and ethics brief

payments.body: The first milestone covers the design and governance infrastructure of the project. Nothing in the research is irreversible at this stage; the budget is used for team time in research design, not for field commitments. The Research Design Document must be reviewed and approved by the CPC before Phase 2 begins. The ethics brief establishes consent management, data classification, and respondent protection protocols before any primary research interaction occurs.

payments.title: M2 — Regional Screening and Desk Research Complete

fields.trigger: CPC confirms priority deep-dive regions from Preliminary Matrix

payments.body: The second milestone produces the first substantive analytical output: the Preliminary Market Prioritisation Matrix. The CPC reviews and confirms the priority deep-dive list before Phase 3 fieldwork is committed. This is the most cost-efficient checkpoint in the research.

payments.title: M3 — Primary Research Substantially Complete

fields.trigger: CPC completes Interim Findings Review; 30+ interactions confirmed

payments.body: The third milestone is the largest single release because it covers the period of highest operational cost: the primary research phase. The contingency allocation (ADA 5,000) may be activated at this stage, with CPC agreement documented before deployment.

payments.title: M4 — Full Draft Deliverables Submitted

fields.trigger: CPC provides written revision brief following draft review

payments.body: The fourth milestone covers the analytical and drafting phase. The full suite of ten core decision outputs is submitted in draft form. The revision brief produced at this checkpoint governs the final delivery in Milestone 5.

payments.title: M5 — Final Delivery and Public Summary

fields.trigger: CPC issues written project completion confirmation

payments.body: The final milestone covers the delivery of revised final outputs, the public summary, the final presentation, and the archiving of the evidence register and supporting documentation. Payment is released upon CPC's written confirmation of project completion.

textBlocks.title: Budget Summary
textBlocks.body: The proposed core budget is ADA 58,000 (~USD 13,340 at $0.23/ADA). All budget items are denominated in ADA and are not conditional on exchange rate. PRISMA's budget is lean relative to scope because existing network infrastructure substantially reduces recruitment and access overhead.

textBlocks.title: Budget Defence
textBlocks.body: The budget is structured to maximise evidence value per ADA spent. The largest single line — ADA 16,000 for primary research — reflects that desk research alone cannot answer counterparty accessibility and adoption signal questions. The regional network access line — ADA 8,500 — covers activating an existing network, not building from scratch. Contingency — ADA 5,000 — requires CPC visibility and agreement before deployment.

textBlocks.title: Payment Overview
textBlocks.body: The ADA 58,000 core budget is released across five milestones tied to verified deliverable submission and CPC acknowledgement of completion. Verification criteria are procedural and evidence-based, not outcome-based. The first two milestones represent ~27% of total budget; Milestone 3 covers primary research; Milestones 4 and 5 cover synthesis and delivery.

textBlocks.title: Public and Community-Facing Outputs
textBlocks.body: A public summary will be produced, excluding confidential or sensitive findings. It will include methodology overview, key regional findings, evidence caveats, publishable recommendations, and a description of the RARF and CASS frameworks for community use.
